evidence: Changes `TxIndex::FindTx` and `TxIndex::FindLegacyTx` in `src/index/txindex.cpp` (+37/-17) to throw on disk read and index corruption errors.
rationale: Prevents txindex from silently returning 'transaction not found' when encountering disk I/O errors or index corruption. Commit e0b20465bb notes that 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception', upholding the category's priority on data integrity over silent bad answers.
